newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus Popular issues CYP15mln bonds.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus Popular issues CYP15mln bonds.

text.p: Cyprus Popular Bank will issue 15 million pounds ($32.9 million) in convertible 10-year bonds priced at par with a coupon of seven percent, the bank announced on Friday.
The issue, due in January, will be offered to existing shareholders pro rata with a minimum purchase of 500 pounds, the bank's board of directors said.
The coupon will be seven percent for the first two years and fluctuate thereafter, to match the mean yield of government bonds in the previous six months.

The bonds are convertible into the bank's ordinary shares at 3.90 pounds per share for the first three years and 4.0 pounds for the next four years. For the final three years they are not convertible.
Popular Bank's ordinary shares closed at 3.30 on the Cyprus Stock Exchange on Friday, down half a cent from last Friday. ($=0.455 pounds)
